OVIRAPTORIDAE and CAENAGNATHIDAE, written up the stems of their nodes, are kept as internal labels; AVIMIMIDAE is written up Avimimus' own line (a single tip) and is not encoded. Multi-way nodes, where a tip line meets the node's horizontal at the stem: Ingenia-Nemegtomaia-Heyuannia, Caenagnathasia-Elmisaurus-the rest, and Leptorhynchos elegans, L. gaddisi, Hagryphus and the Chirostenotes node. Replacement for ramírez-velasco2022a_fig4 (seed 20261203). 23 tips, 3 polytomies (3, 3, 4 children); 2 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 4 case (census 2, seed 20261201).
